params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: on 22 October 2026 at 05:49 one daily bidding digest was not sent because the connection to the mail server (smtp.resend.com:587) timed out. The round went on, but that dealer had no digest that day, because the task runs once a day and does not try again.

Nightwatch #67 (production, `app/Console/Commands/DailyExports.php:85`): `Symfony\Component\Mailer\Exception\TransportException: Connection to "smtp.resend.com:587" timed out.`, marked handled. The catch around the send (R B1-2.16) did its job: it reported the fault and moved on to the next recipient. Nothing retries the mail afterwards, so one network blip at 05:49 costs a dealer a whole day of digest.

A connection timeout is typically gone seconds later. Proposed: give a transport fault one more try after a short pause, and report only when that second try fails as well. Do not retry faults that do not come from the transport (a template that throws): they would fail the same way.

Source: Portal mail:30 (Nightwatch notification forwarded by the owner).
params.title: Daily digest is lost for the day when the mail server connection times out once
